items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: I was introduced to him by Benny Carter who I used to spend every Thursday with when I was in Los Angeles.

ctx.x: I was reading lengthy descriptions of your career and watching videos and this phrase came into my head and I’m going to try it out on you. And the phrase is John Altman is the Quincy Jones of England, and Quincy Jones is the John Altman of America.

Oh I’m very flattered. I was introduced to him by Benny Carter who I used to spend every Thursday with when I was in Los Angeles. And he kept saying to me, “Do you know Quincy Jones?” And I went I know who he is but I don’t know him. And the following week he’d say, “Do you know Quincy Jones?” And I thought you know I’ve got to make allowances, he’s 90 something and getting on and maybe he doesn’t remember what I said last time. Then he had a birthday party and he sat me next to Quincy Jones so I knew there was a…

I’m trying to imagine what you and Quincy Jones would talk about. I had made an assumption early on in this project that musicians when they get together always talk about music. And then I overheard a conversation once with Frank Wess and Joe Williams and a number of other fellas like that and they weren’t talking about music at all.
